# Humanizer reference

Source: https://github.com/blader/humanizer

Imported through the GitHub connector on 2026-11-14. `SKILL.md` version 4.0.0; Git blob SHA `175bf05f45ae3bf566059a560467166d93a9599c`. MIT license, copyright Siqi Chen. This is a project-local copy of editorial guidance, not a global installation or a runtime text-rewriting service.

Applied in embedded mode while revising the five workspace screens and report copy: replace staged slogans, remove inflated claims, state concrete actions, simplify awkward Korean translations, preserve uncertainty and source identifiers. The live scientific titles, DOI/PMID/NCT identifiers, source excerpts, effect estimates and quoted material remain source text. Functional redesign is separate from prose editing.

Review coverage: dashboard, evidence library, HCP preparation, post-visit capture, before/after reports. Older unrelated legacy screens and user-entered text were not rewritten. UI navigation has an English option; most newly added workflow instructions are Korean. The English recording script is provided separately.
